# Physics dependency

Matter.js 0.20.0, MIT, from the official npm registry package `matter-js@0.20.0`.
`matter.mjs` contains upstream `build/matter.min.js` with a small CommonJS-to-ESM wrapper.
License: `matter-LICENSE.txt`. No runtime network access or CDN is required.

Alpha contours are decomposed offline with `poly-decomp@0.3.0` (MIT), vendored in `scripts/vendor/` with its license.

## Research space demo

Three.js 0.170.0, MIT, from the official npm registry package `three@0.170.0`.
`three.module.min.js` is the unmodified upstream browser ES module.
License: `three-LICENSE.txt`. The 3D demo has no runtime CDN dependency.
